exposure.note: openvibe.studio serves Photo (PhotoCraft) and Light (LightCraft), built by our CI from pinned tags, once Studio's vhost replaces the parked redirect.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP

drains: HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained, then the process exits

startupRecovery.none: Studio keeps no state of its own: the apps run in the browser and files live on OpenVibe Download and Pics.

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: Studio has no database; the app bundles are versioned by their pinned tags.

site.name: Studio
site.tagline: Edit photos right in your browser
site.what: Photo for layers and retouching, Light for your library and RAW files: open-source apps, free, with your files on OpenVibe.
